name: vibe-iterate
description: Post-ship product iteration — pick a mode (feature-add, competitive, ux-polish, bug-bash) or reach for a sidecar (:radar, :spy, :scan-releases, :rate, :ship, :upgrade). One PR per session, regression-aware, small-diff-preferred. First-run bootstrap identifies the app type and interviews you for competitors + framework pins. Composes with vibe-cartographer when installed (heavy-iteration delegation). Self-evolves via session + friction logging — :evolve proposes improvements based on your usage patterns. No telemetry.
